test_set_verbosity_level: test setting transformers logging verbosity to error, warning, info, or debug levels
test_logger_integration: test that transformers logger captures warning messages when verbosity allows it
test_env_override_verbosity: test overriding transformers verbosity via the TRANSFORMERS_VERBOSITY environment variable
test_advisory_warnings: test logger warning_advice method respects the TRANSFORMERS_NO_ADVISORY_WARNINGS env var
test_progress_bar_toggle: test disabling and enabling progress bars with disable_progress_bar and enable_progress_bar
